question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Merrill launched a Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) Service to help clients implement tax-efficient transitions and systematic cash deployment within personalized investment strategies.
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services that combine automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment into managed or custom managed investment strategies

items.text: Jay Link, Head of Fiduciary Programs and Platforms at Merrill, said the new services help clients stay focused on their long-term financial goals, including transitioning appreciated assets tax-efficiently and investing cash without timing the market.
items.quote: Investors often face two common challenges: how to transition appreciated assets without realizing all of the tax impact at once, and how to invest cash without feeling pressured to time the market," said Jay Link, Head of Fiduciary Programs and Platforms at Merrill. "These services help clients to stay focused on their long-term financial goals.

items.text: Merrill executives touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm returned to veteran broker recruiting, after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer.
items.quote: Merrill executives in October touted that recruited assets to the wealth unit doubled year-over-year as the firm has returned to veteran broker recruiting. The firm largely pulled back from veteran broker recruiting at the end of 2017 but returned after Co-Presidents Lindsay Hans and Eric Schimpf, who took over in 2023, restored a focus on hiring and a more aggressive offer.

items.text: Merrill continues to invest in recruiting experienced advisors and a training program to improve net new flows, according to CFO Alastair Borthwick.
items.quote: I think the Merrill FA see the value of our franchise and how they can help their own clients over a long period of time, and we're picking up the recruiting of experienced advisors. That isn't an enormous part of our strategy, but it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management

items.text: Merrill's Advisor Development Program roles are designed to build a book of high-net-worth clients through acquiring, building and managing client relationships.
items.quote: Roles are designed to enhance your ability to meet and help clients identify financial goals, align banking and investing solutions and build your book of high-net worth clients.

items.text: Merrill launched new data analytics fees and a basis points revenue share for third-party managers effective January 1, 2027, to give third parties visibility and recommendation from brokers.
items.quote: The fees will give third parties a leg up over competing third parties that decline to pay, but broker incentives will not shift, the company says.

items.text: Merrill added about 4,200 net new households with at least $500,000 in assets in 3Q26 (up 17%), demonstrating demand for advice and ability to attract clients and experienced advisers, per CFO Alastair Borthwick.
items.quote: Merrill added about 4,200 net new households with at least $500,000 in assets, up 17%. And the Private Bank added 470 net new relationships with at least $3 million under management. These results reflect strong demand for advice, and our ability to attract clients and experienced advisers to the platform.

cells.reason: The passages contain leadership statements and strategic initiatives (product launches, recruiting efforts, training programs) indicating Merrill's commitment to capturing wealth, which are facts for this sub-question.
